# 1. Load and Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
cazyme_raw <- read.table("/Users/nickolevillabona/Documents/Chapter2/cazyme_matrix.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE,
                          row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

taxonomy <- read.table("/Users/nickolevillabona/Documents/Chapter2/combined_taxonomy_splitted.txt", sep = "\t",
                        header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

metadata <- read.csv("/Users/nickolevillabona/Documents/Chapter2/bombus_sample_metadata_2026.csv",
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

taxonomy <- taxonomy %>%
  mutate(sample_id = sub("__.*$", "", Genome))

cazyme_df <- cazyme_raw %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genome") %>%
  mutate(sample_id = sub("__.*$", "", Genome))

df <- cazyme_df %>%
  left_join(taxonomy, by = c("Genome" = "Genome")) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("sample_id.x" = "sample_id")) %>%
  rename(sample_id = sample_id.x)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_clean = gsub("g__", "", Genus),
    Species_clean = gsub("s__", "", Snodgrassella),
    country = ifelse(is.na(country), "Unknown", country)
  )

cat("MAGs total:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Genera found:", paste(unique(df$Genus_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Countries:", paste(unique(df$country), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r color-palettes}
genus_colors <- c(
  # Corbiculate Core - azules/verdes
  "Snodgrassella"      = "#007191",
  "Gilliamella"        = "#4DAEDB",
  "Schmidhempelia"     = "#62c8d3",
  "Bifidobacterium"    = "#50ad9f",
  "Bombiscardovia"     = "#4CAF7D",
  "Apibacter"          = "#55B456",
  "Apilactobacillus"   = "#7AC36A",
  "Lactobacillus"      = "#D4E89A",
  # Environmental - naranjas/marrones
  "Fructobacillus"     = "#F39C12",
  "Arsenophonus"       = "#D4AC0D",
  "Enterobacter"       = "#E74C3C",
  # Unknown
  "Unknown"            = "#ECF0F1"
)

country_colors <- c("US" = "#3498DB", "Colombia" = "#EA801C", "Unknown" = "#95A5A6")
```

# 2. CAZyme Overview by Bacterial Genus

## 2.1 Total CAZyme gene counts per genus

```{r total-cazymes-genus, fig.height=5}
cazyme_cols <- names(cazyme_raw)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(total_cazymes = rowSums(select(., all_of(cazyme_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))

genus_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_MAGs = n(),
    mean_cazymes = mean(total_cazymes),
    se_cazymes = sd(total_cazymes) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_cazymes))

ggplot(genus_summary, aes(x = reorder(Genus_clean, mean_cazymes),
                           y = mean_cazymes, fill = Genus_clean)) +
  geom_col(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cazymes - se_cazymes,
                    ymax = mean_cazymes + se_cazymes),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_MAGs)),
            hjust = -0.3, size = 3, color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total CAZyme gene content per bacterial genus",
    subtitle = "Mean ± SE, filtered for #ofTools ≥ 2",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean number of CAZyme genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
```

```{r total-cazymes-genus-country}
genus_summary_country <- df %>%
  filter(Genus_clean != "", !is.na(Genus_clean)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, country) %>%
  summarise(
    n_MAGs = n(),
    mean_cazymes = mean(total_cazymes),
    se_cazymes = sd(total_cazymes) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_MAGs > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_cazymes))

ggplot(genus_summary_country,
       aes(x = reorder(Genus_clean, mean_cazymes),
           y = mean_cazymes, fill = Genus_clean)) +
  geom_col(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cazymes - se_cazymes,
                    ymax = mean_cazymes + se_cazymes),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_MAGs)),
            hjust = -0.3, size = 3, color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ country, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Total CAZyme gene content per bacterial genus",
    subtitle = "Mean ± SE, filtered for #ofTools ≥ 2",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean number of CAZyme genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
```

## 2.2 CAZyme class breakdown by genus

```{r cazyme-class-genus, fig.height=6}
df_long <- df %>%
  select(Genome, Genus_clean, country, all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cazyme_cols),
               names_to = "CAZyme_family",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    CAZyme_class = case_when(
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "GH")  ~ "GH (Glycoside Hydrolase)",
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "GT")  ~ "GT (Glycosyl Transferase)",
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "PL")  ~ "PL (Polysaccharide Lyase)",
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "CE")  ~ "CE (Carbohydrate Esterase)",
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "AA")  ~ "AA (Auxiliary Activity)",
      str_starts(CAZyme_family, "CBM") ~ "CBM (Carbohydrate-Binding Module)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

class_summary <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, CAZyme_class) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean) %>%
  mutate(pct = total_genes / sum(total_genes) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

class_colors <- c(
  "GH (Glycoside Hydrolase)"          = "#A7C957",
  "GT (Glycosyl Transferase)"         = "#907AD6",
  "PL (Polysaccharide Lyase)"         = "#ff99b6",
  "CE (Carbohydrate Esterase)"        = "#F39C12",
  "AA (Auxiliary Activity)"           = "#00b0be",
  "CBM (Carbohydrate-Binding Module)" = "#8fd7d7",
  "Other"                             = "#BDC3C7"
)

ggplot(class_summary,
       aes(x = reorder(Genus_clean, total_genes),
           y = total_genes, fill = CAZyme_class)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "CAZyme class") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "CAZyme class distribution by bacterial genus",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total CAZyme genes (all MAGs combined)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r cazyme-class-country, fig.height=6, fig.width=11}
class_summary_country <- df_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean != "", !is.na(Genus_clean)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, CAZyme_class, country) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, country) %>%
  mutate(pct = total_genes / sum(total_genes) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

class_order <- class_summary_country %>%
  group_by(CAZyme_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(CAZyme_class)

class_summary_country <- class_summary_country %>%
  mutate(CAZyme_class = factor(CAZyme_class, levels = class_order))

ggplot(class_summary_country,
       aes(x = reorder(Genus_clean, total_genes),
           y = total_genes, fill = CAZyme_class)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "CAZyme class") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ country, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "CAZyme class distribution by bacterial genus",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total CAZyme genes (all MAGs combined)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70")
  )
```

# 3. GH and PL Families — Division of Labor

*Replicating Zheng et al. (2019) Fig. 1A approach for Bombus gut MAGs*

## 3.1 Key GH families relevant to pollen polysaccharide digestion

```{r gh-pl-exploration}
df_long %>%
  filter(str_starts(CAZyme_family, "GH") | str_starts(CAZyme_family, "PL")) %>%
  group_by(CAZyme_family) %>%
  summarise(
    total_genes  = sum(count),
    n_MAGs       = n_distinct(Genome),
    mean_per_MAG = mean(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_genes)) %>%
  print(n = 20)

familias_zheng <- c("GH5_25", "GH5_18", "GH28", "GH42",
                     "GH43_4", "GH43_11", "GH43_26", "GH43_31",
                     "GH51_1", "GH78", "PL9_1")

df_long %>%
  filter(CAZyme_family %in% familias_zheng) %>%
  group_by(CAZyme_family) %>%
  summarise(
    total_genes = sum(count),
    n_MAGs      = n_distinct(Genome),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_genes))
```

```{r gh-pl-all-families}
gh_pl_all <- df_long %>%

  ) %>%

  summarise(total_genes = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(gh_pl_all,
```

```{r gh-pl-country-top20}
  )
```

```{r gh-pl-filter-nutrition}
gh_peptidoglycan <- c("GH23", "GH24", "GH25", "GH73", "GH102", "GH103", "GH104")
gh_internal <- c("GH13_29", "GH13_30", "GH13_9", "GH77")

gh_pl_nutrition <- df_long %>%
  filter(
    str_starts(CAZyme_family, "GH") | str_starts(CAZyme_family, "PL"),
    Genus_clean != "", !is.na(Genus_clean)
  ) %>%
  mutate(base_family = str_extract(CAZyme_family, "^GH[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(
    !base_family %in% gh_peptidoglycan,
    !base_family %in% gh_internal
  ) %>%
  group_by(CAZyme_family) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total))

print(gh_pl_nutrition, n = 30)

df_long %>%
  filter(CAZyme_family %in% c("GH1", "GH3", "GH32", "GH186", "GH4")) %>%
  group_by(CAZyme_family, Genus_clean) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(CAZyme_family, desc(total)) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

```{r gh-heatmap-key, fig.height=7, fig.width=12}
key_families <- c(
  # Hemicellulose (Bifidobacterium-associated)
  "GH5_25", "GH5_18",
  "GH43_4", "GH43_11", "GH43_26", "GH43_31",
  "GH42",
  "GH51_1",
  "GH78",
  # Pectin (Gilliamella-associated)
  "GH27", "GH28",
  "PL9_1",
  # General carbohydrate metabolism
  "GH1", "GH3",
  "GH13_29", "GH13_9",
  "GH23",
  "GH32"
)

key_families_present <- key_families[key_families %in% cazyme_cols]

heatmap_df <- df %>%
  select(Genome, Genus_clean, all_of(key_families_present)) %>%
  arrange(Genus_clean)

row_annot <- data.frame(
  Genus   = heatmap_df$Genus_clean,
  Country = df$country[match(heatmap_df$Genome, df$Genome)],
  row.names = heatmap_df$Genome
)

mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  select(-Genus_clean) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genome") %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(mat) <- paste0(row_annot$Genus, "_",
                         sub(".*__", "", rownames(mat)))

col_annot <- data.frame(
  Class = case_when(
    str_starts(colnames(mat), "GH") ~ "GH",
    str_starts(colnames(mat), "PL") ~ "PL",
    str_starts(colnames(mat), "CE") ~ "CE",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  row.names = colnames(mat)
)

annot_colors <- list(
  Genus   = genus_colors[unique(row_annot$Genus)],
  Country = country_colors,
  Class   = c("GH" = "#E74C3C", "PL" = "#2ECC71", "CE" = "#F39C12")
)

pheatmap(
  mat,
  annotation_row    = row_annot,
  annotation_col    = col_annot,
  annotation_colors = annot_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FEE8C8", "#E34A33", "#800026"))(50),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  fontsize_row      = 8,
  fontsize_col      = 9,
  main = "Key CAZyme families for polysaccharide digestion\n(gene count per MAG)",
  angle_col         = 45,
  border_color      = "grey80"
)
```

## 3.2 GH and PL profiles — bubble plot (Zheng et al. style)

```{r bubble-plot-genus, fig.height=6, fig.width=11}
gh_pl_cols <- cazyme_cols[str_starts(cazyme_cols, "GH") | str_starts(cazyme_cols, "PL")]

bubble_data <- df %>%
  select(Genus_clean, all_of(gh_pl_cols)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   list(mean = mean, cv = ~sd(.)/mean(.))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Genus_clean,
               names_to = c("family", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "(.+)_(mean|cv)") %>%
  filter(mean > 0) %>%
  mutate(CAZyme_class = ifelse(str_starts(family, "PL"), "PL", "GH"))

informative_families <- c(
  "GH43_4", "GH43_11", "GH43_26", "GH43_31",
  "GH42", "GH51_1", "GH78",
  "GH5_18", "GH5_25",
  "GH28", "PL9_1",
  "GH1", "GH3", "GH32", "GH186", "GH25", "GH30"
)

genus_order <- c(
  "Snodgrassella", "Gilliamella", "Schmidhempelia",
  "Bifidobacterium", "Bombiscardovia",
  "Apibacter",
  "Apilactobacillus", "Lactobacillus",
  "Fructobacillus", "Arsenophonus"
)

bubble_plot_df <- bubble_data %>%
  filter(family %in% informative_families,
         Genus_clean != "Enterobacter",
         Genus_clean %in% genus_order) %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = factor(Genus_clean, levels = rev(genus_order)))

ggplot(bubble_plot_df,
       aes(x = family, y = Genus_clean,
           size = mean, color = cv)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 12), name = "Avg. genes\nper MAG") +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#884ab2", "#d1105a", "#ff930a"),
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "Coeff. of\nvariation",
    limits = c(0, 2)
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ CAZyme_class, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Glycoside Hydrolase gene families in Bombus gut MAGs",
    subtitle = "Bubble size = mean gene count per MAG | Color = variability among MAGs | Grey = single MAG",
    x = "CAZyme family",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    panel.spacing    = unit(0.5, "lines")
  )
```

```{r bubble-plot-country, fig.height=6, fig.width=11}
bubble_data_country <- df %>%
  select(Genus_clean, country, all_of(gh_pl_cols)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, country) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   list(mean = mean, cv = ~sd(.)/mean(.))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Genus_clean, country),
               names_to = c("family", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "(.+)_(mean|cv)") %>%
  filter(mean > 0) %>%

bubble_plot_country_df <- bubble_data_country %>%

    Genus_clean = factor(Genus_clean, levels = rev(genus_order)),
    country     = factor(country, levels = c("US", "Colombia", "Unknown"))

ggplot(bubble_plot_country_df,
       aes(x = family, y = Genus_clean,
           size = mean, color = cv)) +

    colors = c("#884ab2", "#d1105a", "#ff930a"),
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "Coeff. of\nvariation",
    limits = c(0, 2)
  ) +
  facet_grid(CAZyme_class ~ country, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "GH gene families in Bombus gut MAGs",
    subtitle = "Bubble size = mean gene count per MAG | Color = variability among MAGs | Grey = single MAG",
    x = "CAZyme family",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10),
```

# 4. US vs Colombia Comparison

## 4.1 Total CAZyme content by country and genus

```{r country-comparison, fig.height=6}
df_country <- df %>%
  filter(country %in% c("US", "Colombia")) %>%
  select(Genome, Genus_clean, country, total_cazymes)

ggplot(df_country, aes(x = Genus_clean, y = total_cazymes,
                        fill = country, color = country)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA,
               position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                               dodge.width = 0.8),
              size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Total CAZyme gene content: US vs Colombia",
    subtitle = "Each point = one MAG",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total CAZyme genes",
    fill = "Country",
    color = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

## 4.2 GH vs PL gene content by country

```{r gh-pl-country-boxplot, fig.height=5}
df_ghpl <- df %>%
  filter(country %in% c("US", "Colombia")) %>%

  ))

  labs(

    y = "Gene count per MAG"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

  )
```

# 5. Full CAZyme Heatmap (all MAGs)

```{r full-heatmap, fig.height=14, fig.width=14}
mat_full <- df %>%
  select(Genome, Genus_clean, all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genome")

keep_cols <- cazyme_cols[colSums(mat_full[, cazyme_cols] > 0) >= 2]
mat_full <- mat_full[, keep_cols] %>% as.matrix()

row_annot_full <- df %>%
  select(Genome, Genus_clean, country) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genome") %>%
  rename(Genus = Genus_clean, Country = country)
row_annot_full <- row_annot_full[rownames(mat_full), ]

col_annot_full <- data.frame(
  Class = case_when(
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "GH")  ~ "GH",
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "GT")  ~ "GT",
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "PL")  ~ "PL",
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "CE")  ~ "CE",
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "AA")  ~ "AA",
    str_starts(colnames(mat_full), "CBM") ~ "CBM",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  row.names = colnames(mat_full)
)

annot_colors_full <- list(
  Genus   = genus_colors[names(genus_colors) %in% unique(row_annot_full$Genus)],
  Country = country_colors,
  Class   = c("GH" = "#E74C3C", "GT" = "#3498DB", "PL" = "#2ECC71",
              "CE" = "#F39C12", "AA" = "#9B59B6", "CBM" = "#1ABC9C")
)

rownames(mat_full) <- paste0(row_annot_full$Genus, "\n",
                              sub(".*__", "", rownames(mat_full)))

pheatmap(
  mat_full,
  annotation_row    = row_annot_full,
  annotation_col    = col_annot_full,
  annotation_colors = annot_colors_full,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FFF7BC", "#FEC44F", "#D95F0E", "#8C2D04"))(60),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  fontsize_row      = 7,
  fontsize_col      = 7,
  main = "Complete CAZyme profile — all Bombus gut MAGs\n(families present in ≥2 MAGs, #ofTools ≥ 2)",
  angle_col         = 45,
  border_color      = NA
)
```

# 6. Ordination — CAZyme Functional Diversity

```{r pcoa, fig.height=6}
mat_ord <- df %>%
  select(all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(mat_ord) <- df$Genome

mat_ord <- mat_ord[rowSums(mat_ord) > 0, ]

dist_bc <- vegdist(mat_ord, method = "bray")
pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_bc, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

eig_pct <- round(pcoa_res$eig[1:2] / sum(pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  Genome = rownames(mat_ord),
  PC1    = pcoa_res$points[, 1],
  PC2    = pcoa_res$points[, 2]
) %>%
  left_join(df %>% select(Genome, Genus_clean, country, species_id),
            by = "Genome")

ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                     color = Genus_clean, shape = country)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Genus_clean),
                   size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 8,
                   fontface = "italic") +
  scale_color_manual(values = genus_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("US" = 16, "Colombia" = 17, "Unknown" = 15),
                     name = "Country") +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA of CAZyme functional profiles (Bray-Curtis)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70")
```

```{r pcoa-ellipses}
ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genus_clean)) +

               level = 0.75, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = country), size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genus_colors, name = "Genus") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("US" = 16, "Colombia" = 17, "Unknown" = 15),
                     name = "Country") +
```

```{r upset-subgenus, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
upset_data <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(subgenus), subgenus != "") %>%
  select(Genome, subgenus, all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Genome, subgenus),
               names_to  = "family",

  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(subgenus, family) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = subgenus,
```

```{r donut-subgenus, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
pie_data <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(subgenus), subgenus != "") %>%
  select(Genome, subgenus, all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Genome, subgenus),

  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subgenus) %>%
  mutate(
    prop        = total / sum(total),
    grand_total = sum(total)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    subgenus = factor(subgenus, levels = c(
      "Fervidobombus", "Pyrobombus", "Cullumanobombus",

  )

                                    margin = margin(b = 5)),
```

# 9. CAZyme Richness by *Bombus* Host Species

```{r richness-setup}
# CAZyme richness = number of unique families present (count > 0) per MAG
df <- df %>%
  mutate(cazyme_richness = rowSums(select(., all_of(cazyme_cols)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

# Bee subgenus color palette
subgenus_colors <- c(
  "Fervidobombus"   = "#E74C3C",
  "Pyrobombus"      = "#E67E22",
  "Cullumanobombus" = "#9B59B6",
  "Separatobombus"  = "#3498DB",
  "Bombias"         = "#2ECC71",
  "Psithyrus"       = "#95A5A6"
)
```

## 9.1 CAZyme richness per MAG by host bee species

```{r richness-per-mag, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
df_richness <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_id), species_id != "")

species_order_mag <- df_richness %>%
  group_by(species_id) %>%
  summarise(med = median(cazyme_richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(med) %>%
  pull(species_id)

df_richness <- df_richness %>%
  mutate(species_id = factor(species_id, levels = species_order_mag))

ggplot(df_richness, aes(x = species_id, y = cazyme_richness)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = subgenus), alpha = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Genus_clean), width = 0.2, size = 2.5,
              alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = subgenus_colors, name = "Host subgenus",
                    na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_color_manual(values = genus_colors, name = "Bacterial genus") +
  labs(
    title    = "CAZyme family richness per MAG by host bumblebee species",
    subtitle = "Each point = one MAG; color = bacterial genus",
    x        = expression(italic("Bombus") ~ "species"),
    y        = "CAZyme family richness (# unique families)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "italic"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9)
  )
```

## 9.2 Community-level CAZyme richness per bee sample

```{r community-richness-calc}
# Community richness: all unique CAZyme families present across any MAG
# recovered from the same bee individual
mags_per_sample <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_id), species_id != "") %>%
  count(sample_id, name = "n_MAGs")

sample_richness <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_id), species_id != "") %>%
  select(sample_id, species_id, subgenus, country, all_of(cazyme_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cazyme_cols),
               names_to = "family", values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, species_id, subgenus, country, family) %>%
  summarise(present = any(count > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, species_id, subgenus, country) %>%
  summarise(community_richness = sum(present), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(mags_per_sample, by = "sample_id")

# Summary table
sample_richness %>%
  group_by(species_id, subgenus) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bees      = n(),
    mean_rich   = round(mean(community_richness), 1),
    median_rich = median(community_richness),
    sd_rich     = round(sd(community_richness), 1),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_rich)) %>%
  print(n = 25)

# Kruskal-Wallis test
kw <- kruskal.test(community_richness ~ species_id, data = sample_richness)
cat("\nKruskal-Wallis test across bee species:\n")
print(kw)
```

```{r community-richness-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
species_order_comm <- sample_richness %>%
  group_by(species_id) %>%
  summarise(med = median(community_richness), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(med) %>%
  pull(species_id)

sample_richness <- sample_richness %>%
  mutate(species_id = factor(species_id, levels = species_order_comm))

kw_label <- paste0("Kruskal-Wallis  p = ",
                   formatC(kw$p.value, format = "g", digits = 3))

ggplot(sample_richness, aes(x = species_id, y = community_richness)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = subgenus), alpha = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(size = n_MAGs), color = "grey30",
              width = 0.2, alpha = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = subgenus_colors, name = "Host subgenus",
                    na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), name = "MAGs\nrecovered") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = kw_label,
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title    = "Community-level CAZyme richness by host bumblebee species",
    subtitle = "Unique CAZyme families across all MAGs recovered per bee | Point size = # MAGs",
    x        = expression(italic("Bombus") ~ "species"),
    y        = "Community CAZyme richness (# unique families)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

